scripts.dev:clean: for port in 3000 3001 8081; do lsof -ti tcp:$port 2>/dev/null | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 1; turbo run dev
scripts.sync-api-types: cd ../backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python export_openapi_json.py && cd ../frontend && npx openapi-typescript ../backend/openapi.json -o ./packages/shared-types/src/api-schema.d.ts
